interventions.recipe: Add .cursor/rules/*.mdc with code guidelines and acceptance-check reminders. Template: framework/templates/rules/code-guidelines.mdc
interventions.measurement_signal: rules_context activity=1 during dev; fewer convention regressions
interventions.expected_mechanism: Raises R via repository context; can lower Hc-driven decay
interventions.retest: Rerun same medium/high tasks baseline vs no_rules

prerequisites: MCP server or .cursor/mcp.json available to cloud agents
interventions.recipe: Enable repo MCP / design-system MCP on experiment base branch; keep nomcp branch for ablation
interventions.measurement_signal: mcp_context activity during dev; arm contrast no_mcp
interventions.expected_mechanism: Raises R by grounding tool use in repo truth
interventions.retest: baseline vs no_mcp on medium+high strata

interventions.recipe: Make deterministic tests a required branch-protection check. Template: framework/templates/workflows/ci-gate.yml
interventions.expected_mechanism: Raises R by deterministic rejection of invalid work

prerequisites: Cursor Cloud Automations or equivalent orchestration
interventions.recipe: Enable QA Agent + Fix Agent with label handoffs; cap repair rounds (default 3). See harness/AUTOMATION-PROMPTS.md
interventions.measurement_signal: qa-failed/needs-fix events; repair_iterations; combined arm no_recovery_loop
interventions.expected_mechanism: Raises R through detect+repair; report QA+fix together unless separated

prerequisites: Cursor hooks support on the agent path
interventions.recipe: Install framework/templates/hooks/hooks.json completion guard: block done until acceptance criteria, tests, and QA evidence exist; force one repair
interventions.measurement_signal: hook challenge events; stop-boundary false completions
interventions.retest: hook-on vs hook-off; do not claim live Modus fit until telemetry exists

interventions.recipe: Require development-ready issues with pinned acceptance criteria before /approve
interventions.measurement_signal: spec:refined vs spec:raw; lower σspec proxy
interventions.expected_mechanism: Lowers D via reduced specification ambiguity

interventions.recipe: Enable one review bot as ablatable factor; disable conflicting review workflows in baseline
interventions.expected_mechanism: Raises R before human review; does not replace human review
